name: static_fan_out_joins_all_branches
workflow:
digraph T {
  start [shape=Mdiamond]
  exit [shape=Msquare]

  fork [shape=component]
  a [prompt="x"]
  b [prompt="x"]
  merge [shape=tripleoctagon]
  report [prompt="x"]
  start -> fork
  fork -> a
  fork -> b
  a -> merge
  b -> merge
  merge -> report -> exit

}
departure: Fabro records the branches as parallel branch events, not stages, so its path omits `a` and `b`, and keeps branch context under parallel.results without merging it. Under Petri every branch is a node with a final record, branch results ride tokens into the fan-in's output, and a branch's context_updates still merge into kv.
